metrics.name: Unique beneficiaries enrolled
metrics.definition: Count of distinct people in the intake file after duplicate merging, with an enrollment date inside the reporting period.
exclusions: rows flagged as duplicates are merged, not counted twice
rows with missing enrollment date are counted separately as 'date unknown' and not silently included
metrics.caveat: People with a missing or out-of-period enrollment date are listed as excluded, not guessed.

metrics.name: Active participants
metrics.definition: Unique enrolled beneficiaries with at least 2 sessions marked present.
exclusions: attendance rows that cannot be matched to an enrolled beneficiary
'present' values that are not a recognised yes/no

metrics.name: Total session attendances
metrics.definition: Count of attendance rows marked present, matched to an enrolled beneficiary, after removing exact duplicate rows.
exclusions: rows that cannot be matched to an enrolled beneficiary (reported separately)
'present' values that are not a recognised yes/no

metrics.name: Average confidence gain
metrics.definition: Mean of (Confidence After - Confidence Before) across matched survey respondents with both scores valid (1-5). If a person has several surveys, use the latest one.
metrics.caveat: Self-reported and not a control-group comparison; shows reported change, not proven program impact.

metrics.name: Survey response rate
metrics.definition: Number of M1 beneficiaries with at least one valid survey response, divided by M1.
metrics.caveat: Survey-based figures such as M4 only describe the people who responded.
